Class PFMotor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.pf.PFMotor
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseMotor, DCMotor
public final class PFMotor extends Object implements DCMotor
One output of a Power Functions receiver as a DCMotor: a motor, light or servo plugged into the red or the blue port of a receiver on a channel. Create it once at startup with its port, as RcxMotor is bound to its output, and it sends single-output commands to that port only, so the other port is left alone.

The power percentage is mapped onto the protocol's seven speed steps: 100 percent is speed 7, and each step is about 14 percent. The protocol does not say which motor is plugged in (XL, L, M or servo), so this class does not either. isMoving() reports the last command sent, because the receiver sends no feedback.
